name: Ultra Mahou Shoujo Manana vol.2
original_name: ウルトラ魔法少女まなな vol.2
source:
The Earth is being targeted by many “invaders”. The humanity was defenseless to their assaults until magical girl Manana showed up. She claims to have come from a magical star. She can pierce monsters' defenses like light pierces darkness and despair, but her destructive magic equally damages everything around. Is humanity doomed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
地球正遭到众多“侵略者”觊觎。面对它们的攻击，人类原本毫无抵抗能力，直到魔法少女真奈奈现身。她自称来自一颗魔法星球，能够像光芒刺破黑暗与绝望一样贯穿怪物的防御；然而，她破坏力惊人的魔法也会同样摧毁周围的一切。人类注定要灭亡吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
